name: Annotation Inbox
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
When you turn the plugin off, it stops syncing and stops writing to your vault.
When you turn it back on, it waits for its last save to finish before it reads its sync data.
tip: You can keep your own text outside the marker comments; the plugin never touches it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Annotation Inbox is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
